# Isaac Vazquez

> Product manager and UC Berkeley Haas MBA Candidate with 6+ years across SaaS, analytics, civic tech, and QA-to-product work. Builds AI workflow, fintech, sports-data, and decision-support products.

Isaac Vazquez is a product manager and UC Berkeley Haas MBA Candidate, Class of 2027. His background spans product strategy, quality engineering, data analytics, civic technology, fintech-style tooling, and AI workflow products. He is a Consortium Fellow and MLT Professional Development Fellow.

Last reviewed: 2026-09-24

Legacy `/projects`, `/work`, and `/blog` URLs redirect permanently to their canonical routes. The on-site `/search` page is a lightweight navigation layer over a limited, mostly hand-maintained index. Most dashboards read a committed snapshot that a scheduled job refreshes, so each one shows where its numbers came from and when.

## Fintech and research tools

- [Investment Research](https://isaacvazquez.com/investments): Public investment research platform with portfolio tracking, quote snapshots, stock comparisons, and retirement-planning experiments.
- [Interchange IQ](https://isaacvazquez.com/fintech-tools/interchange-iq): Payment fee analyzer comparing flat-rate and interchange-plus processor economics with adjustable volume, ticket size, and card mix.
- [Budget Planner](https://isaacvazquez.com/fintech-tools/budget-planner): Browser-persisted budgeting workspace for income, category planning, savings targets, and manual expense tracking.
- [Rent vs. Buy Calculator](https://isaacvazquez.com/fintech-tools/rent-vs-buy): Month-by-month net-worth model that credits the renter the opportunity cost of the down payment and finds the year buying pulls ahead.

## Fantasy football tools

- [Rankings](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football): Snapshot-backed rankings with position filters, scoring formats, tier views, ADP signals, and draft prep.
- [Weekly Board](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/weekly): In-season weekly flex and quarterback consensus rankings with each player's opponent and rostered rate.
- [Waiver Targets](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/waivers): In-season adds where the weekly consensus rank runs ahead of how widely a player is rostered, with the rank, percentile, and rostered rate beside each gap.
- [Trade Calculator](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/trade-calculator): Compares one-QB redraft trades using expert consensus, mock-draft ADP, and league settings, with visible source dates and data limits.
- [Draft Assistant](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/draft-tracker): Manual snake-draft tracker with local persistence, roster-pressure cues, queueing, notes, and comparison state.
- [Mock Draft Simulator](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/mock-draft): Rehearses the early rounds of a one-QB draft against a seeded room that picks from the published consensus board and market ADP.
- [Best Ball Rankings](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/best-ball): Best ball rankings with Underdog ADP, contest specific strategy, and expected return math for Best Ball Mania and related formats.
- [Best Ball Draft Assistant](https://isaacvazquez.com/fantasy-football/best-ball/draft-tracker): Manual best ball draft tracker with contest specific roster targets and a room-relative Draft Outlook.

## AI and product tools

- [Frontier Model Tracker](https://isaacvazquez.com/frontier-models): Curated model comparison for context windows, pricing, modalities, reasoning support, and product-selection tradeoffs.
- [AI Dev Tools](https://isaacvazquez.com/ai-dev-tools): Directory of AI coding and agent tools with pricing, model support, source links, and market context.
- [Agent Build Index](https://isaacvazquez.com/agent-build-index): Weekly ranking of public AI agent repositories by measured GitHub star movement, with source, freshness, and baseline disclosures.
- [GitHub Trending Pulse](https://isaacvazquez.com/github-trending-pulse): Daily snapshot of active public GitHub repositories by language and topic, including weekly star movement.
- [Decision Lab](https://isaacvazquez.com/decision-lab): Product-bet triage tool that scores impact, confidence, effort, and reversibility before recommending ship, test, or hold.
- [Automation Enablement Assistant](https://isaacvazquez.com/enablement-assistant): Recommends a standard test stack, builds an onboarding plan, answers setup questions, and tracks documentation gaps.
- [Tech Startup Tracker](https://isaacvazquez.com/tech-startup-tracker): Curated private-company tracker by sector and funding stage, with valuation, latest round, total raised, and momentum context.
- [News Pulse](https://isaacvazquez.com/news-pulse): RSS-backed media analytics for coverage patterns, topic frequency, and lightweight sentiment across major outlets.
- [MBA Internship Notifications](https://isaacvazquez.com/mba-internship-notifications): Recruiting tracker for MBA internships and business roles across public company job boards.
- [Score Pools](https://isaacvazquez.com/score-pools): Exact-score prediction engine for soccer fixtures, using odds de-vig and a market-calibrated Dixon-Coles scoreline model with an expected-points optimizer.

## Writing topics

- [Agentic AI](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/agentic-ai): AI agents, orchestration, model economics, evaluation, security, delegation, and production product decisions.
- [PM Workflows](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/pm-workflows): AI workflows for product discovery, research synthesis, PRDs, roadmaps, stakeholder communication, and product decisions.
- [Systems & Quality](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/systems-quality): Reliability, testing, architecture, AI evaluation, security, and the engineering judgment behind production systems.
- [Fintech Product & Pricing](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/fintech-product-pricing): Investment research, payment processing economics, pricing strategy, and financial decision tools.
- [Sports & Fantasy](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/sports-fantasy): Sports analytics, fantasy football strategy, World Cup analysis, bracket models, and the data products behind the predictions.
- [Signals & Commentary](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/signals-commentary): Analysis of technology, AI infrastructure, markets, policy, careers, and the signals shaping product strategy.
- [Space & Experiments](https://isaacvazquez.com/writing/topics/space-experiments): Space missions, launch economics, experimental dashboards, and side projects.
